projecthero.guide.omnitrix.alien.snare_o: A Thep Khufan: a mummy whose bandages stretch, lash and wrap whatever they reach. He whips and binds with them, yanks creatures in, swings and zips about on them, and wraps everything round him at once. His body is hollow and full of sand: he can send a hand flying off on a bandage to grab something, or come apart into loose bandages for a moment so nothing can touch him. Shots pass through his empty wrappings, but his dry bandages burn easily. He is not on the dial at first: an 11th mistransform (or 22nd, 33rd...) may find him, and from then on you can dial him.
message.projecthero.omnitrix.snare_oh.no: Nothing up there for a bandage to catch on.
projecthero.omnitrix.snare_oh.bandage_wh: A bandage lashes out at the crosshair (8 blocks): 7, knocked back.
projecthero.omnitrix.snare_oh.bandage_bi: A bandage winds round the creature you look at (14 blocks): 6, and it is bound in place for 3 s (a boss 0.75 s).
projecthero.omnitrix.snare_oh.grapple_pu: A bandage catches the creature you look at (16 blocks) and yanks it to you: 8. A boss is too heavy, so it pulls you to it instead.
projecthero.omnitrix.snare_oh.bandage_sw: Hold X: a bandage shoots up to the block under the crosshair (36 blocks; with nothing there, up and ahead) and you swing on it for as long as X is held. Jump reels in, Sneak pays out. Let go to fling yourself on. No fall damage until you land.
projecthero.omnitrix.snare_oh.bandage_zi: A bandage to the block under the crosshair (40 blocks), and it reels you straight in.
projecthero.omnitrix.snare_oh.mummy_wrap: Bandages burst out of you at everything within 7 blocks: 16, and they are all bound in place for 2.5 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.snare_oh.unravel_sp: Spin with your bandages flying loose round you (4.5 blocks): three lashes of 5 (15 in all), the last one knocking them back.
projecthero.omnitrix.snare_oh.detach.des: Send a hand flying off on its bandage to the crosshair (20 blocks): 8 to what it catches, and it drags it back to you.
projecthero.omnitrix.snare_oh.scatter.de: Come apart into loose bandages for 1.5 s: nothing can hurt you, you slip along fast and nearby mobs lose you. Then you pull yourself back together in a burst of sand: 6 within 3 blocks. Press again to reform early.
projecthero.omnitrix.snare_oh.hollow_bod: Arrows and other shots pass through your empty wrappings: they do half damage.
projecthero.omnitrix.snare_oh.sand_fille: No fall damage from under 8 blocks, and you can't suffocate or drown.
projecthero.omnitrix.snare_oh.dry_wrappi: Your old bandages burn easily: fire does half again and clings to you longer.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.snare_oh.role: Bandage controller: whips, binds and yanks from range, swings about on bandages, and slips out of trouble.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.snare_oh.passi: Hollow Body: shots and arrows do half damage.
Sand Filled: no fall damage under 8 blocks, never suffocates or drowns.
Swings (hold X) and zips (Shift+X) on his bandages.
Can send a hand off (V) or come apart to dodge (Shift+V).
projecthero.omnitrix.info.snare_oh.weakn: Dry Wrappings: fire does half again and burns longer.
